confirmation: Up to three positive screening candidates, selected by net gain and then earlier pass, distinct fingerprints; identical separate 256-question cohort and F4 control.
freeze: Select one candidate only if confirmation net > 0, ranking pooled screen+confirmation net, confirmation net, earlier parent pass.
validation: Four disjoint balanced 512-question cohorts; each has paired F4 and frozen candidate. No weight changes based on validation.
dev: One final dev evaluation only after the frozen candidate meets the validation gate; never tune on that result.
fallback: Restore exact F4 ae81f3cb05285df3 if no candidate survives. Previously measured dev 30.12%; do not claim a new dev score.
